channel.title: Celebrity MasterChef
channel.desc: After three weeks of intense competition, the heats are over and only the best nine cooks remain. Now, it's the first of the semi-finals and the celebrities will be tested on their teamwork with their toughest challenge so far. Split into three teams, the celebrities venture outside the MasterChef kitchen for the first time for a tough challenge.
